text:
sam: woke up to my YAML leaving me a horoscope: 'Today your version will face uncertainty.' :crystal_ball:
lucy: mine left a sticky: 'semver strolls into town, brings chaos and muffins.' :muffin:
ben: new term: tab-sandwich. when a file has a tab between two spaces and your parser orders lunch and never returns.
ci-bot: Lint results: config.yml:8: tab-sandwich detected. Recommended treatment: `make lint-yaml` and offer snacks.
sam: tiny poll: what would you rather debug at 3am? :one: semver horoscope, :two: tab-sandwich
lucy: :one: semver horoscopes confuse the changelog.
ben: :two: tab-sandwich silently erases your weekend.
sam: found a PR title: "fix: apologized to YAML and offered tea" with diff:
```diff
- version: 0.9.0
+ version: 0.9.0-trying-really-hard
```
lucy: compiler joke i heard: "The optimizer went to therapy; it had unresolved priorities." :laughing:
ben: commit message contest: winner so far: "chore: feed the linter and promise to be better"
ci-bot: Policy reminder: avoid non-semver tags like `v1.0-feels` for production. Ambiguous tags may trigger auto-rollback.
sam: closing notes: respect whitespace, don't let semver gamble, and bring muffins to calm the configs. Emoji summary: :muffin: :coffee: :bug:
